ei.title: Chapter 1-02 2번: From Terror to Relief in a Car
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: It seemed I was asleep only for a few minutes in my car when I was suddenly awakened by something banging on my car door. I looked through every window, but no one was there. The hitting was getting louder. My mind started racing as I tried to contain the terror that was inching its way into my heart. I desperately screamed, "Please help me!" My eyes were shut as I screamed. As I shook with fear, I noticed the hitting had stopped. As I slowly forced my eyes to open, I saw there was a man tapping on my window. He was an older man, who didn't look dangerous. "Hello there," he said. "I saw your car on the side of the road. Is everything okay?" I couldn't think of a time I had ever been gladder to see someone.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ more louder → louder: 1음절 비교급은 -er. more louder는 이중 비교급 오류.
det.analysis:
❌ ① asleep — was asleep: 보어 형용사 적절
❌ ② banging — something banging: 현재분사 적절
✅ ③ more louder — 원문 louder. 이중 비교급(more + -er) 오류 ←정답
❌ ④ racing — mind started racing: V-ing 적절
det.tip: 비교급: louder (more louder ✕ — 이중 비교급)

det.korean: '쉬는(resting)'이 아니라 '빠르게 도는(racing)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 공포에 질린 상태에서 마음이 빠르게 돌아간다.

❌ ④ slowly — 서서히, 원문 일치
det.tip: racing(빠르게 도는) ↔ resting(쉬는)

questions.passage: It seemed I was asleep only for a few minutes in my car when I was suddenly awakened by something banging on my car door. I looked through every window, but no one was there. The hitting was getting louder. My mind started racing as I tried to contain the terror that was inching its way into my heart. I desperately screamed, "Please help me!" My eyes were shut as I screamed. As I shook with fear, I noticed the hitting had stopped. As I slowly forced my eyes to open, I saw there was a man tapping on my window. He was an older man, who didn't look dangerous. "Hello there," he said. "I saw your car on the side of the road. Is everything okay?" I couldn't think of a time I had ever been gladder to see someone.
